notes: PNG alpha preserves A1R5G5B5's stored 1-bit alpha.
Opaque black in additive-blend assets is retained; no automatic background removal.
BIN.bak uses the corresponding GCZ.bak when present and the current GCZ otherwise.
All GCZ files are exported, including pages not referenced by the supplied BIN files.
Animation name tables are preserved as metadata; animation timing and compositing are not rendered.
